Where to Deploy a Python App: An Honest Decision Guide

It depends on how your app runs. A Django, Flask, or FastAPI app is a long-running process that sits behind a WSGI or ASGI server, so a persistent home (a managed platform, or a VPS you run yourself) suits an always-on app with a database and background jobs. Serverless functions fit light, bursty, stateless endpoints, but their cold starts and request timeouts get in the way of long requests, streaming, and steady background work.
